context: Replaces a bare .pipe() chain in the image resizer with stream/promises' pipeline for error handling.
explanation: This fixes a real gap: chained .pipe() calls don't forward errors between streams, so a decode failure or a full disk on the write side previously left dangling, unhandled errors and file descriptors. pipeline() propagates errors from any stream in the chain, destroys every stream on failure, and resolves/rejects a single promise the caller can await, making resizeImage properly awaitable and its failures catchable.
